name: Purdue University Northwest
tuition_note: In-state (Indiana resident) full-time undergraduate banded tuition & fees 2025-26 from pnw.edu/bursar/tuition-and-fees/fall-2025-summer-2026-rates/: $4,335.80/semester (tuition $3,911.05 + composite fee $424.75) x 2 = $8,671.60 annual. Housing: room only, 2025-26 six-person suite double room rate $4,808 from pnw.edu/housing/costs-and-payment/ (published room-only rates range $4,808-$8,000; no meal plan/board included). 2026-27 rates also published (e.g. Calumet Hall double $6,250).
